nodes.label: Weekly Summary Screen Design
nodes.description: Atmospheric dark-toned gym photograph used as a background or hero image asset for the Weekly Summary screen. The image shows a dumbbell, a water bottle, and a white towel resting on a gym bench in the foreground, with blurred gym equipment (racks, cardio machines) visible in a dark background. The overall mood is dark, moody, and fitness-focused — consistent with the app's dark theme (background #222831). No UI chrome, charts, or stats are visible; this is a purely decorative/illustrative asset used to set the visual tone of the WeeklySummaryView.
nodes.visual_design_notes: Dark desaturated palette with near-black tones; shallow depth of field isolates foreground gym props; monochromatic with slight cool tint; aligns with IFit app's permanent dark theme
